## Checklist

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`cd backend && npm test`)
- [ ] Frontend lint, tests and build pass (`cd frontend && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build`)
- [ ] New screens or features have a browser test (English and Nepali)
- [ ] New text uses `t("...")` and has a Nepali version
- [ ] New API routes are documented (`npm run docs:api`)
